1.videoPrompt:
【Generation Goal】
Generate a polished stylized low-poly 3D crime-drama animation ad video: a father receives a chilling ultimatum from his crime boss down the phone, closing on him white-knuckled and alone with the weight of his family's fate.

【Reference Asset Roles】
@Image1 defines Character 1's identity: the protagonist — a stylized low-poly 3D adult male with a thick black beard, short dark brown hair, tan skin, and a heavy anxious brow, wearing a grey crew-neck t-shirt with a subtle all-over graphic pattern. Use it only for his facial structure, hair, beard, skin tone, and shirt; do not adopt the pose, sunglasses, or any background element shown.
@Image2 defines the home living-room environment: a clean modern 3D-rendered interior with dark green walls, light wooden flooring, a wall-mounted TV over a low console unit, a pendant lamp, and a central open floor area. Reproduce it exactly as a full-bleed backdrop; keep the central floor area clear and maintain the room's depth.
@Image3 defines the sole smartphone prop: a modern smartphone in a bright orange matte silicone case. Use it only for the phone's shape, case color, and form factor — do not adopt the incoming-call screen interface, the isometric angle, or the transparent background shown. Exactly one orange-cased smartphone appears in the video.
@Image4 defines Character 2's identity: the boss — a stylized low-poly 3D adult male with slicked black wavy hair, a groomed black goatee, gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses, and a sharp jaw, wearing a dark grey pinstripe suit jacket over a crisp white dress shirt and a black tie. Use it only for his facial structure, hair, goatee, sunglasses, and suit; do not adopt the portrait framing or any background. Exactly one plain black smartphone appears when the boss is on screen.

【Subjects and Relationships】
Character 1 is an animated low-poly 3D man in his early 30s, American, with short dark brown hair, a thick black beard, tan skin, a heavy anxious brow, and simplified facial features with smooth flat textures, wearing a grey crew-neck t-shirt with a subtle all-over graphic pattern, worn untucked. He stands inside the living room, pressing the orange-cased phone to his ear; he acts inside the world and never looks at the camera. His voice is low, tight, finely grainy, early 30s, American-accented English, frayed at the edges.
Character 2 is an animated low-poly 3D man in his late 30s, American, with slicked black wavy hair, a groomed black goatee, gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses, and a sharp jaw with smooth flat textures, wearing a dark grey pinstripe suit jacket over a crisp white dress shirt and a black tie. He is seated in his study, holding a plain black smartphone to his ear; he acts inside the world and never looks at the camera. His voice is deep, smooth, cold, late 30s, American-accented English, never raised.

【Event Script】
Two locations: first, a modern apartment living room at night — dark green walls, a wall-mounted TV over a low console, a pendant lamp, pale plank floor, framed art and a small planter; a single warm overhead pendant pools light on the floor with deep shadow in the corners — a safe home turned tense. Second, a dim private study — a leather chair, dark wood, low warm lamplight, heavy shadow; a low warm side lamp throws high-contrast golden pools against deep shadow, controlled and predatory. Both spaces rendered in polished stylized low-poly 3D crime-drama animation, moody cinematic lighting, hard-edged shadows, flat smooth textures, saturated deep palette — dread barely contained.
<a low tense synth drone with a slow bass pulse begins and runs underneath>

【Pronunciation】
Wherever "Pawn to Don" is spoken, it is pronounced "pawn too don".

【Stage 1】(0–4s)
At the start, a locked-off medium close-up, chest up, eye level, Character 1 centered with a dark window behind him: he stands just inside the living room, pressing the orange-cased smartphone hard against his ear, going completely still — jaw tightening, brow lowering, as the call lands on him like a blow. Character 2 speaks, cold and unhurried, down the phone line, in American-accented English, at a medium, deliberate pace: {You missed the payment. Your family's my collateral now.} At the end Character 1 is frozen in place, phone pressed to his ear, face locked in dread.

【Stage 2】(4–8s)
Cut to a slow push-in, close-up, eye level, Character 2 centered with warm shadow behind him: the boss is seated in the dim study, lifting a plain black smartphone to his ear and speaking without any hurry, his expression flat and unreadable behind the gold-rimmed aviators. Character 2 continues, flat and final, with a faint undercurrent of menace, in American-accented English, at a medium, measured pace: {A hundred thousand. By dawn. Or I come and collect.} At the end the camera has tightened on the boss's face, the lamplight catching the gold rims of his sunglasses, his expression unmoved.

【Stage 3】(8–12s)
Cut to a locked-off medium close-up, chest up, eye level, Character 1 centered with the dark window behind him: he slowly lowers the orange-cased smartphone from his ear and turns his gaze toward the dark window, his grip tightening around the phone white-knuckled, fingers pressing hard into the bright orange case. His breath catches, shoulders drawing in, the fight to think visible in the tension across his jaw. Character 1 speaks, breath catching, barely holding together, in American-accented English, with high urgency: {They've got my wife. My son.} <a single deep bass hit lands as the words settle> At the end he stands still, phone gripped at his side, staring into the dark window, the weight of the moment written across his face.

Character 1 speaks only his own scripted line; Character 2 speaks only his own scripted lines; when each is speaking the other is off-screen. No subtitles, captions, or overlay text appear; no logo or watermark appears anywhere in the frame. Preserve the authorized identities and designs in the supplied game references. Keep newly invented supporting elements original and copyright-safe. Do not generate duplicate or twin characters; keep only a single instance of each character in frame.

【Maintain Consistency】
Keep Character 1 as one continuous character — same short dark brown hair, thick black beard, tan skin, grey crew-neck graphic t-shirt worn untucked, and orange-cased smartphone — across all shots set in the living room. Keep Character 2 as one continuous character — same slicked black wavy hair, groomed black goatee, gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses, dark grey pinstripe suit jacket, white dress shirt, and black tie, holding a plain black smartphone — across his shots in the study. Keep both characters' identities and outfits distinct and stable, never swapping their appearances or roles. Maintain exactly one orange-cased smartphone in Character 1's scenes and exactly one plain black smartphone in Character 2's scene. Keep the living-room geography — dark green walls, pendant lamp, wall-mounted TV, pale plank floor — and the warm pooled overhead light with deep corner shadow consistent across Stages 1 and 3. Keep the study geography — leather chair, dark wood, warm side lamp — and its high-contrast golden lamplight consistent in Stage 2. Maintain the polished low-poly crime-drama animation style, flat smooth textures, and moody cinematic grade throughout. The synth drone and bass pulse run continuously beneath the whole video.
